# Project Instructions

- Build a full-stack Next.js TypeScript NEXUDAYA reconstruction.
- Use Tailwind CSS, App Router, Prisma/PostgreSQL, and reusable components.
- Do not copy proprietary/private source, accounts, credentials, or user data from the reference site.
- Use only user-owned or replaceable placeholder assets; never invent government recognition.
- Keep public pages, registration/login, dashboards, verification, store, and admin workflows functional.
- Track progress and test each implementation stage.
